questions.question: Born on this day in 1967, which Scottish musician gained fame as the lead vocalist of the rock group Texas?
questions.explanation: Sharleen Spiteri is the contralto lead vocalist and songwriter for the Scottish band Texas.
questions.context:
On this day in 1967: Sharleen Spiteri, Scottish singer-songwriter and actress
Sharleen Spiteri (Scottish singer (born 1967)): Sharleen Eugene Spiteri is a Scottish singer-songwriter and guitarist who has a contralto vocal range, best known as the lead singer of the rock band Texas, who rose to prominence in 1989 with the release of their debut single "I Don't Want a Lover".

questions.question: Which Japanese director was responsible for writing, directing, and creating the visual effects for the 2026 kaiju film Godzilla Minus Zero?
questions.explanation: Godzilla Minus Zero was written and directed by Takashi Yamazaki, who also oversaw the film's visual effects.
questions.context: Godzilla Minus Zero (2026 Japanese film by Takashi Yamazaki): Godzilla Minus Zero  is a 2026 Japanese epic kaiju film written, directed, and with visual effects by Takashi Yamazaki. A sequel to Godzilla Minus One (2023), it is the 39th film in the Godzilla franchise, the 34th film thereof produced by Toho, and the sixth installment in the franchise's Reiwa era.

questions.question: During his service with the Spanish military, by what first name was English conspirator Guy Fawkes also known?
questions.explanation: Guy Fawkes used the alternate name Guido Fawkes while serving the Spanish forces.
questions.context: Guy Fawkes (English participant in the Gunpowder Plot (1570–1606)): Guy Fawkes, also known as Guido Fawkes while fighting for the Spanish, was a member of a group of provincial English Catholics involved in the failed Gunpowder Plot of 1605. He was born and educated in York; his father died when Fawkes was eight years old, after which his mother married a recusant Catholic.

questions.question: Portuguese football icon Cristiano Ronaldo serves as team captain for which club in the Saudi Pro League?
questions.explanation: Cristiano Ronaldo captains and plays as a forward for the Saudi club Al-Nassr.
questions.context: Cristiano Ronaldo (Portuguese footballer (born 1985)): Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for and captains the Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr. He represented the Portugal national team for 23 years, which he also captained for 19 years. Nicknamed CR7, he is widely regarded as one of the greatest footballers of all time and the greatest Portuguese football player of all time.

questions.question: Which British television presenter began her broadcasting career at Sky Sports News in 1998 before later co-hosting The Great British Breakfast on GB News?
questions.explanation: Kirsty Gallacher started working with Sky Sports News in 1998 and later co-presented The Great British Breakfast in 2021.
questions.context: Kirsty Gallacher (British TV presenter (born 1976)): Kirsty Jane Gallacher is a British television presenter and model. She began her career at Sky Sports News in 1998 and hosted Kirsty's Home Videos, RI:SE and Simply the Best before returning to Sky Sports News from 2011–2018. From June 2021 until December 2021, Gallacher co-presented The Great British Breakfast on the news channel GB News.
